question: Does the unchanged four-surface state confirm directly on a second three-target cohort frozen before RGB and model access?

predecessor.single_change: Replace the opened posthoc cohort with the second pre-RGB, model-blind physical-target-disjoint cohort. Keep all four surface responsibilities, models, masks, cycle thresholds, component selection, affine transport and extent gate unchanged.

source.target_scope: New physical targets 35, 15 and 4 were selected after excluding all targets in six prior cohorts. Selection considered frozen geometry order, opened 9471 pose/depth members, zero RGB and zero models. The cohort shares scan families and backgrounds with prior Development.

reference_binding.support_surface: One native reference SAM2 mask from the provider reference bbox.
reference_binding.extent_surface: The provider reference bbox used only as the complete reference extent.
reference_binding.query_truth_isolation: Query bbox opens only after the transported extent is frozen and is used only for evaluation.

proposal.transport: Unchanged full-frame symmetric RoMa, 0.05 bilateral certainty, in-bounds target, 0.013888888888888888 round-trip error, largest 8-connected reference support component, ordinary least-squares affine map and transported bound-extent corners.
proposal.component_tie_break: Maximum component area then lowest label; no fallback.
proposal.mask: One native reference SAM2 support mask and one native query SAM2 support mask; no selection, morphology, expansion or retry.
proposal.query_extent: The transported bbox is the geometric output; the query SAM2 mask is identity support only.

matcher.absolute_support: Unchanged bilateral one-percent identity-support cycle fraction and majority purity.

forbidden_after_freeze: change any surface role, model, threshold, component, affine fit, frame, target or gate
use query truth to generate or select the extent
treat support-mask bbox IoU as a required geometric output or hide it as a diagnostic
retry or replace a failed sample
claim same-provider confirmation raw-camera binding, provider independence, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, arrival, handoff, Android, benefit, reliability or safety
claim_boundary: A pass is second-cohort physical-target-disjoint same-provider Development confirmation that the frozen four-surface component transfers to three new door/doorframe targets. It still uses privileged initial reference bboxes, shares scan families/backgrounds, tests only three targets, and runs desktop GPU models. The query SAM mask is identity support rather than a pixel-accurate geometric output. It is not raw-camera initial binding, provider-independent generalization, open-world absence authority, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, Android deployment, user benefit, reliability or safety.
